items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 21 October 2026 11:40pm
items.description:
##Today##

Dry and bright during the day, then heavy rain overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 13°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

20-25, up to 30


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

W or NW 15-20, decreasing SW 10-15 around midday, then gradually backing SE during the afternoon. Increasing E or SE 20-25 overnight, then backing N'ly 25-30 gusting 35-40 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in any rain later.


##Comments##

Strong winds developing, gales overnight.


##Tomorrow##

Very windy with gales, rain clearing to showers later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 12°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

3-6


##Wind Speed##

35


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

W or NW 35-40 gusting 45-50, risk of occasionally 45-50 gusting 55-60, decreasing 25-30 gust 35-40 in the evening, then 20-25 overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor becoming good occasionally moderate later. Hill fog at first.


##Comments##

Detail of forecast is uncertain, will be dependent on depth and track of the low.


##Saturday, 24 October 2026##

Dry at first but then with outbreaks of rain arriving for the afternoon.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 13°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-20


##Wind Speed##

25


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

NW 20-25, quickly decreasing W or SW 15-20, increasing S 20-25, occasionally 30, veering W or SW later, then increasing 30-35 gusting 40-45 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good at first, then falling moderate or poor in rain later. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds.


##Sunday, 25 October 2026##

Very windy with isolated showers and only isolated showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 12°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-4


##Wind Speed##

35


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 30-35 gusting 40-45, risk of 35-40 gusting 45-50 for a time, decreasing 20-25 in the evening, then SW 15-20 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Comments##

Gales, risk of severe gales. Forecast winds uncertain due to track of low uncertain.
